ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels concentrated in central lobe regions versus 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels dominant along the lateral margins and the entire trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous regions are visible. The left lobe region features heavy low-intensity mottling and pixel fragmentation. The right lobe region is more contiguous but is bisected by several distinct, high-contrast dark linear streaks oriented diagonally from the trailing edge toward the interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding box depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the trailing edge; the left lobe shows higher amplitude peaks (10-15 pixels) compared to the more uniform micro-serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the leading edges of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, circular, high-intensity pixels (approx. 3-8 pixels in diameter) are visible along the black leading edges and on the distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least four distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks on the ventral surface of the right lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake-mark scarring on the right lobe; irregular jaggedness and potential minor tissue loss along the distal third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical internal pigmentation patterns, with the left lobe showing significantly more internal speckling/mottling compared to the cleaner right lobe.
